summary: The first frame the Crew sends after the upgrade. It names the protocol version, the mode and the features the Crew offers.
planPosition: A refused hello gets an error frame first and then close 4401 with the error code as the close reason, so the Crew can tell a version refusal from a token refusal.
encoding: One JSON object per WebSocket text frame, UTF-8. Unknown fields are ignored by the receiver.

mode.notes: "http" in version 1. "acp" is reserved for a later mode and refused in version 1.

features.notes: Features the Crew offers. Unique, at most 16, each at most 32 characters. Known in version 1: flow-credit, ws-flow, request-credit. "opaque" is reserved and never offered in version 1.

client.notes: Optional diagnostics, name at most 64 characters and version at most 32. Never used for routing or checks.

valid.name: crew offers response and WebSocket flow control

invalid.name: missing protocolVersion
invalid.expect: error invalid_message, then close 4401 with reason invalid_message

invalid.name: version below the relay's minimum
invalid.expect: error version_unsupported, then close 4401 with reason version_unsupported

invalid.name: reserved mode
invalid.expect: error mode_unsupported, then close 4401 with reason mode_unsupported

invalid.name: features not an array
invalid.expect: error invalid_message, then close 4401 with reason invalid_message

timing: The relay closes with 4408 when no hello arrives within 10 seconds of the upgrade. A second hello after ready gets error invalid_message and is otherwise ignored.
